target_isolation: Separate empty target directory for every build; independent private cache stores per compiler wrapper

trials.cache: warm, different checkout path and changed CLI source

source_change_control.edit: Append KACHE_9112_EDIT_FIRED to CLI about text

limitations: Sequential trials on a shared runner under unrelated CI load; wall times are observations, not a controlled distribution or merge-queue p90.
The first two Kache reports inferred the common target parent as session root; their per-checkout counters were unmeasured. Explicit KACHE_EVENT_ROOT fixed attribution for the source-change control.
A checkout session can span multiple Cargo commands or consecutive jobs; the finalizer does not claim per-job attribution.
This trial builds the CLI; it does not establish workspace test-unit or package-verification latency.
